speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou art out of it. Dead by the third, and the gown off by four, and the yard did not thin for the want of thee.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is the side. I am not giving it a name on the way home. The scarf goes on, and the book can keep the title.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Sweet Master Shakespeare, out of a gown and into a scarf. There is a whole jig in the distance between the two, and I am not offered it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You have the jig you were offered on Monday, Will. This afternoon had no fool in the part I came off, and I am not inventing one in the passage.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Leave the passage. Thou wert heard while thou wert alive, which is the bargain. Go home before Kemp finds a third name for the scarf.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Two is plenty. Sweet, and scarfed. I can wait till Saturday to be paid for the poetry of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Saturday can have the poetry. I am taking the jaw home, and the name of the side is staying on the peg.
